requirements.title: Entitlement and usage enforcement

Implement approved write/read/export behavior for trial, active, past-due, cancelled and expired states without erasing history or blocking safety-critical access by assumption. Return explicit entitlement errors and usage totals scoped to doctor practice; client metadata and hidden buttons cannot grant paid capabilities.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-002 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Subscription checkout or approved manual-payment process
requirements.summary: Use an approved payment route; never assume account/provider eligibility or reuse another product secret. Acceptance: Choose an approved checkout or manual-payment route with verified account eligibility, currencies, cost/refund terms and server credentials ownership. Create server-side quote/payment intent from approved price/version and doctor subscriber identity; browser totals/return URLs are untrusted. Use only sandbox or synthetic manual evidence; no account creation, charges, paid API or production callback activation is included. Prepare evidence for DOS-M6-GATE-PAYMENT. requirements.title: Payment confirmation and reconciliation
requirements.summary: Use trusted payment evidence, duplicate-event handling and reconciliation; browser return is not authority. Acceptance: Accept payment confirmation only through verified provider evidence or approved audited manual review, bound to payment intent, amount/currency and subscriber. Persist duplicate/out-of-order event handling, idempotent entitlement update and reconciliation of pending/unknown outcomes. Verify callback authentication and replay protection; retain financial history and exclude sensitive payment data from logs.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-004 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Renewal, cancellation and subscription settings
requirements.summary: Provide auditable lifecycle changes and accurate doctor-facing billing state. Separate requested cancellation from effective expiry and provider confirmation; retain invoices/payment history and auditable changes. Show accurate current, pending and failed billing state, retry safely and preserve allowed record access under expiry policy.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-005 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Practice service prices and visit charges

Use exact monetary arithmetic and explicit rounding/discount approval rules; tax applicability remains gated.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-006 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Collections, receipts and refunds
requirements.summary: Implement atomic patient-payment/receipt/refund flows with appropriate approvals and immutable financial history. Acceptance: Post patient collections, allocations, receipt numbers and refunds atomically with idempotency, exact amounts and approved authorization. Preserve immutable financial entries and link corrections/refunds to originals; no destructive edit/delete of paid history. Prevent over-allocation and over-refund under concurrency, record pending/unknown external outcomes and reconcile before retrying money movement.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-007 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Egypt tax-document applicability and adapter decision

requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-008 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.
